description: This file defines a React component 'RepoTable' used to display a table of repository items with key metadata. It includes interface definitions for repository data, rendering logic for loading, error states, and repository details, along with helper functions for formatting dates and skeleton loading rows.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a string date into a locale-specific date string or returns default placeholders if input is invalid.

methods.name: SkeletonRow
methods.description: Renders a placeholder row with animated skeleton blocks during loading state.
